title: Build REST API Endpoints
description: You are given a Node.js Express application skeleton. Your task is to implement the missing REST API endpoints for a user management system. The endpoints should handle CRUD operations for users.

features.name: GET /api/users
features.description: Implement an endpoint to retrieve all users with optional pagination and filtering.
testCases: Should return all users when no filters applied
Should support pagination with page and limit parameters
Should filter users by name when query parameter provided
Should return 200 status code on success

features.name: POST /api/users
features.description: Implement an endpoint to create a new user with validation.
testCases: Should create a new user with valid data
Should return 201 status code on successful creation
Should return 400 status code for invalid data

features.name: PUT /api/users/:id
features.description: Implement an endpoint to update an existing user.
testCases: Should update user with valid data
Should return 200 status code on successful update
Should return 404 status code if user not found

features.name: DELETE /api/users/:id
features.description: Implement an endpoint to delete a user.
testCases: Should delete user when ID exists
Should return 204 status code on successful deletion
Should return 404 status code if user not found
Should handle cascading deletions if applicable
